description: Bio-Techne Corporation and its subsidiaries develop, manufacture and sell life science reagents, instruments and services for the research, diagnostics and bioprocessing markets worldwide. Its broad product portfolio and application expertise enable scientific investigations into biological processes and molecular diagnostics, revealing the nature, diagnosis, etiology and progression of specific diseases, aid drug discovery efforts and provide the means for accurate clinical tests and diagnoses. It manages the business in two operating segments, Protein Sciences, a leading developer and manufacturer of high-quality biological reagents used in all aspects of life science research, diagnostics and cell and gene therapy which also includes proteomic analytical tools, and Diagnostics and Spatial Biology, and its customers include researchers in academia and industry, chiefly pharmaceutical and biotech companies and contract research organizations, as well as diagnostic, companion diagnostic and therapeutic customers.
